objective: Test two bidirectional completed-candle families based on range expansion and native-volume-confirmed momentum, without symbol-specific or timeframe-specific tuning.

rules.name: V15-CHOP14-X38-DONCHIAN20+RVOL1.25+EMA200-EXIT10-H240M
rules.entry: Choppiness(14) crosses below 38.2 while the completed close breaks the prior 20-bar range, volume is at least 1.25x SMA20 and price agrees with EMA200
rules.exit: Completed close crosses the opposite prior 10-bar channel, 1% stop or 240-minute timeout

rules.name: V15-PVT12/26/9-X+EMA200+ADX18-H240M
rules.entry: Price Volume Trend EMA12 minus EMA26 crosses its EMA9 signal, aligned with EMA200, ADX14 at least 18 and matching DMI direction
rules.exit: PVT oscillator crosses back through its signal, 1% stop or 240-minute timeout

execution.funding: exact Lighter hourly settlements in (entry, exit]
